query:
UPDATE plans
         SET orders_total = $2,
             orders_unassigned = $3,
             routes_total = $4,
             status = CASE WHEN $4::bigint = 0 THEN 'done' ELSE 'routing' END,
             finished_at = CASE WHEN $4::bigint = 0 THEN now() END
         WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'queued'
         RETURNING status
